title: Jeans Have a Watch Pocket
caption:
Jeans have a tiny pocket built for a pocket watch

It is the small square pocket sitting above the right front pocket, and almost nobody uses it for its original job. Before wristwatches were common, people carried a pocket watch and needed somewhere to keep it safe. Denim makers stitched that little compartment in for exactly that. When watches moved to the wrist, the pocket stayed, because the design was already famous.

Now it holds a lighter, a ticket, a coin or nothing at all. Look at your own jeans and you will find it there.

Send this to the person who always wondered what that pocket was for.

job.narration: That tiny jeans pocket is not for coins. It was built for a pocket watch. When watches moved to the wrist, the pocket stayed. And that is why it is still there.
